title: Avo-7-part-2
description: Avionics examination covering electronic flight displays, engine and fuel indication systems, temperature measurement, vibration sensing, EICAS, ECAM, FDR, and aircraft display systems.

questions.question: EADI commonly displayed:
options: B. Attitude and situation flight parameter
questions.explanation: The EADI provides attitude and other flight situation information to the pilot.

questions.question: In mass flow turbine relation with indicator:
options: C. Turbine rotation has no relation to flow rate
questions.explanation: In the mass-flow system, increased fuel flow produces increased turbine rotation.

questions.question: EADI & EHSI locate:
options: A. Only below the engine display
B. Only on the center pedestal
C. Side by side or top to bottom
questions.explanation: EADI and EHSI displays may be arranged side by side or one above the other depending on the aircraft design.

questions.question: FDR is commonly called:
questions.explanation: The Flight Data Recorder (FDR) is commonly referred to as a black box.

questions.question: Which EICAS alert level requires immediate crew action?
questions.explanation: Level A EICAS alerts require immediate crew action because they indicate serious conditions.

questions.question: In fuel quantity tank unit float connect to:
questions.explanation: The float moves the wiper on a variable resistor as the fuel level changes.

questions.question: ECAM display mode:
questions.explanation: The provided answer is three automatically, referring to automatic ECAM display modes.

questions.question: Water level indicate on:
options: B. Attendant panel and water service panel
questions.explanation: Aircraft water quantity information is indicated on the attendant panel and water service panel.

questions.question: DU overheat b/s:
options: C. Vents blocked, insufficient cooling air, or DU malfunction
questions.explanation: Display unit overheating can result from blocked vents, insufficient cooling air, or a malfunctioning display unit.

questions.question: Ratiometer needle moved by:
questions.explanation: The ratiometer uses magnetic interaction involving a large permanent magnet to move the indication mechanism.

questions.question: In ratiometer operation:
options: A. Hydraulic pressure moves the pointer
B. Electromagnetic interaction with permanent magnet
C. Mechanical friction moves the pointer
questions.explanation: Ratiometer operation depends on electromagnetic interaction with a permanent magnet.

questions.question: An electrical fuel indicator equipment indicates fuel remaining and total range:
questions.explanation: A fuel totalizer provides information about fuel remaining and range based on fuel consumption.

questions.question: The indication on a thermocouple-type EGT indicator is produced by:
options: B. Current generated by T° difference between hot & cold junction
questions.explanation: A thermocouple generates an electrical output due to the temperature difference between its hot and cold junctions.

questions.question: In the ratiometer T° measuring indicator T° sensor is:
questions.explanation: The temperature sensor in a ratiometer system is a resistance element whose resistance changes with temperature.

questions.question: The voltage produced by thermocouple is:
options: A. Inversely proportional to applied T°
B. Directly proportional to applied T°
questions.explanation: Within its operating range, thermocouple output voltage increases with the temperature difference applied to its junctions.

questions.question: Where are the hot and cold junctions located in an engine cylinder T° indicating system?
options: B. Hot junction at cylinder, cold junction at instrument
C. Hot junction at cockpit, cold junction at cylinder
questions.explanation: The hot junction senses cylinder temperature while the cold junction is located at the instrument.

questions.question: Which of the following is not electrical type temperature measuring device:
questions.explanation: A bimetallic thermometer operates mechanically through differential thermal expansion rather than an electrical measuring principle.

questions.question: The fuel T° indicator on B737-NG is:
questions.explanation: The B737-NG fuel temperature indicator uses a resistance ratiometer instrument.

questions.question: Fluid quantity can be measured in:
questions.explanation: Fluid quantity can be expressed as either volume or mass.

questions.question: In a capacitance fuel quantity system, what parameter of the capacitors is changed as the level of the fuel in the fuel tank changes?
questions.explanation: As fuel level changes, the dielectric material between the capacitor plates changes from air to fuel or vice versa, changing capacitance.

questions.question: Which thermocouple is used to measure the exhaust gas T° for turbine engine?
questions.explanation: Chromel-alumel thermocouples are commonly used for high-temperature turbine engine measurements.

questions.question: What are the vibration pickups used on Boeing aircraft?
options: B. Electromechanical velocity pickups, piezoelectric accelerometer
questions.explanation: Boeing aircraft can use electromechanical velocity pickups and piezoelectric accelerometers for engine vibration measurement.

questions.question: DEU forward of data shown on display unit are:
options: A. PFD, ND, and engine display
B. Fuel tank and water panel
questions.explanation: The DEU provides display data for units such as the PFD, ND, and engine display.

questions.question: Collect data from many avionic and airframe system:
questions.explanation: The Display Electronics Unit (DEU) collects and processes data from multiple avionics and airframe systems for display.

questions.question: Primary engine display shows:
questions.explanation: N1 is a primary engine parameter and is shown on the primary engine display.

questions.question: Thermocouple connection:
questions.explanation: The provided answer is parallel, referring to the stated thermocouple connection arrangement.

questions.question: Thermocouple used on spark plug:
questions.explanation: A gasket-type thermocouple can be installed with a spark plug to sense cylinder temperature.

questions.question: Thermocouple output voltage is generated by:
options: B. Differential potential between hot and cold junction
questions.explanation: Thermocouple voltage results from the differential potential created by the temperature difference between the hot and cold junctions.

questions.question: Vane-type fuel flow is a:
questions.explanation: A vane-type fuel-flow system provides remote indication of fuel flow.

questions.question: Which of the following is not true:
options: A. Bourdon tube is used to measure EGT
C. EGT measurement uses temperature sensing
questions.explanation: The provided incorrect statement is that a Bourdon tube is used to measure EGT; EGT is normally measured electrically using thermocouples.

questions.question: Which of the following is true:
options: A. Oil temperature measuring system never uses mechanical sensing
B. Oil temperature measuring system usually used Bourdon tube for old aircraft
C. Oil temperature cannot be measured electrically
questions.explanation: Older aircraft may use Bourdon-tube arrangements for oil temperature indication.

questions.question: AOA sensor types are:
questions.explanation: The provided answer states that there are two types of AOA sensors.

questions.question: Remote fuel quantity indication:
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies the DC fuel quantity indicator as the remote fuel quantity indication system.

questions.question: ULB operate under water at least:
questions.explanation: The underwater locator beacon (ULB) is designed to operate underwater for at least 90 days.

questions.question: Fuel flow sensing device injector clogged:
options: A. True reading due to low pressure
B. False reading due to high pressure
C. No reading due to temperature
questions.explanation: A clogged injector can create abnormal pressure conditions and result in a false fuel-flow indication.

questions.question: ECAM display failure:
questions.explanation: The provided answer is Undertaken procedure, referring to the procedure followed after an ECAM display failure.

questions.question: Status page display in Airbus aircraft is in:
questions.explanation: The Airbus ECAM status page is displayed on the central upper display.

questions.question: Engine vibration is:
questions.explanation: Engine vibration is treated as a secondary engine parameter and is shown on the secondary display.

questions.question: ____ is used in modern aircraft fuel quantity:
questions.explanation: Modern aircraft fuel quantity systems can use mass as the fuel quantity parameter.

questions.question: How many vibration pickups per engine:
questions.explanation: The provided answer specifies two vibration pickups per engine.

questions.question: Velocity pickups used:
options: A. Permanent magnet, coil of wire, spring supports
questions.explanation: An electromechanical velocity pickup consists of a permanent magnet, coil of wire, and spring supports.

questions.question: A350/380 generated its own:
questions.explanation: The provided answer states that the A350/A380 system generates its own symbols and choices for display.

questions.question: TAT probe used for velocity is above:
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies Mach 0.2 as the point above which the TAT probe is used for velocity-related measurement.

questions.question: First electronics displays to be employed:
questions.explanation: EADI and EHSI were among the first electronic flight displays employed in aircraft.

questions.question: Brightness inputs to the DEU:
options: A. Fuel sensors and pressure switches
B. Brightness control panel, RLS and BLS sensors
questions.explanation: Brightness information supplied to the DEU comes from the brightness control panel and the RLS and BLS sensors.

questions.question: Attitude indication is a:
questions.explanation: Attitude is continuously presented on the Primary Flight Display (PFD).

questions.question: Which of the following components make the image data for all the display units (DU)?
questions.explanation: The Graphic Generator produces the image and graphic data required for the display units.

questions.question: Which of the following is engine secondary parameter:
questions.explanation: N² speed is classified as a secondary engine parameter in the provided material.

questions.question: Which of the following EICAS message requires immediate corrective action and is displayed in red:
questions.explanation: A Warning message is displayed in red and requires immediate corrective action.

questions.question: In the Wheatstone temperature measuring indicator the T° sensor is:
questions.explanation: A resistance element is used as the temperature sensor in a Wheatstone bridge temperature measuring system.

questions.question: Which is not true about proximity sensor:
options: A. It can detect an object without contact
C. It can be used for position sensing
questions.explanation: A proximity sensor normally detects the presence or position of an object without physical contact.

questions.question: Which one of the following parameter is considered a status/system parameter:
questions.explanation: Door and hydraulic indications are examples of status or system parameters.

questions.question: Which statement is correct concerning a thermocouple type T° indicating instrument system:
options: A. It requires an external power source
B. It requires no external power source
C. It can only operate with hydraulic pressure
questions.explanation: A thermocouple generates its own electrical voltage from the temperature difference between its junctions, so no external power source is required for basic operation.

questions.question: ____ is the true T° the one you would measure if the airplane was not moving through space:
questions.explanation: Static air temperature is the temperature of the air without the temperature rise caused by aircraft motion.

questions.question: Data used to switch on during icing condition:
questions.explanation: Total Air Temperature (TAT) information can be used by aircraft systems to identify icing-related conditions.

questions.question: Which one of the following sensor is used on large commercial aircraft to warn the pilot when aircraft is approaching stall:
options: B. AOA sensor installed around the nose area
questions.explanation: Angle of Attack (AOA) sensors located around the nose area provide information used for stall warning.

questions.question: In a magnetic drag cup tachometer, the purpose of the permanent magnet is:
options: A. To create eddy current in the drag cup
questions.explanation: The rotating permanent magnet creates eddy currents in the drag cup, producing torque that moves the pointer.

questions.question: What is the T° sensor that is used for cabin air T° indication:
options: B. Thermistor element in sealed housing
questions.explanation: A thermistor element in a sealed housing is used to sense cabin air temperature.

questions.question: For fuel flow measurement, a reciprocating engine uses:
questions.explanation: A vane-type fuel flow meter can be used to measure fuel flow in a reciprocating engine.

questions.question: ____ with move up/down together with oil level:
questions.explanation: Floating magnets move upward or downward with the oil level and operate the associated sensing switches.

questions.question: T° of Exhaust gas can be measured at the:
options: A. Exit or inlet of turbine unit
questions.explanation: Exhaust gas temperature can be measured at suitable locations such as the turbine inlet or exit.

questions.question: Water quantity sensor in a Copper mesh:
questions.explanation: A copper mesh can form part of a capacitance-type water quantity sensing system.

questions.question: What makes a needle (on drag cup) steady:
questions.explanation: The hairspring provides the controlling force that stabilizes the pointer at the appropriate indication.

questions.question: In magnetic drag cup tachometer, the pointer of the indicator is kept at specific reading point by:
questions.explanation: The hairspring provides the restoring torque that balances the magnetic torque and positions the pointer.

questions.question: In capacitor fuel:
questions.explanation: Fuel acts as the dielectric material in a capacitance-type fuel quantity probe.

questions.question: Direct fuel quantity indication is possible in:
questions.explanation: Direct fuel quantity indication is practical in light aircraft because the tank and indicator can be relatively close together.

questions.question: Engine oil temperature uses:
questions.explanation: A temperature bulb can be used to sense engine oil temperature.

questions.question: Ratiometer temperature sensor type is:
questions.explanation: A resistance-type sensor changes resistance with temperature and is used with the ratiometer system.

questions.question: Attitude display on:
questions.explanation: Aircraft attitude is displayed on the Attitude Director Indicator (ADI) or Electronic Attitude Director Indicator (EADI).

questions.question: Flight director commands display on:
questions.explanation: Flight director commands are displayed on the Primary Flight Display (PFD).

questions.question: ____ used electrical power ratiometer for T° measurement:
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies direct current as the electrical power used by the ratiometer temperature system.

questions.question: In mass flow fuel indicating system the purpose of impeller is:
options: B. To make fuel hit turbine blade at angle
questions.explanation: The impeller directs the fuel onto the turbine blades at an angle, causing turbine rotation proportional to fuel flow.

questions.question: In mechanical tachometer when speed of engine increase:
options: C. Pointer moves directly to zero
questions.explanation: As rotational speed increases, centrifugal force causes the flyweights to move outward.

questions.question: Capacitor fuel quantity tank probe installed:
questions.explanation: Capacitance fuel quantity probes are installed vertically so that the changing fuel level changes the portion of the probe immersed in fuel.

questions.question: Which of the following is not true:
options: A. Bimetallic thermometer can be used for EGT
B. Thermocouple can be used for EGT
C. EGT is a temperature measurement
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies the bimetallic thermometer statement as not true for EGT measurement.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct about thermocouple:
options: C. It uses only a resistor
questions.explanation: A thermocouple is made from two dissimilar metals that produce a voltage when their junctions have different temperatures.

questions.question: Tachometer indicator is responsive to change in:
questions.explanation: Electronic tachometer systems can determine rotational speed from the frequency of the generated electrical signal.

questions.question: CRT displays are still employed in:
questions.explanation: CRT displays have remained in service on some older aircraft such as the Bombardier Dash 8.

questions.question: Which one is incorrect:
options: A. Thermocouple is used to measure fluid temperature
B. Thermocouple produces voltage from temperature difference
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies this statement as incorrect according to the source material.

questions.question: If the thermocouple leads are inadvertently crossed at installation cylinder T° gauge pointer indicated:
options: B. Scale pointer moves to zero
questions.explanation: Crossing the thermocouple leads reverses the polarity of the generated voltage, causing the cylinder temperature gauge pointer to move to zero.

questions.question: Which one of the following annunciation of failure that triggers another failure:
options: A. Repetitive chime sounds, master warning lights
questions.explanation: Repetitive chimes and master warning lights provide prominent crew annunciation of serious failures.

questions.question: Ram rise occurs to small degree at all airspeed but not starts becoming factor above:
questions.explanation: Ram rise is present to a small degree at all airspeeds but becomes a significant factor above approximately 200 knots.

questions.question: ULB is activated:
questions.explanation: An underwater locator beacon (ULB) is activated when submerged underwater.

questions.question: How many mandatory parameters are recorded in modern jet aircraft FDR:
questions.explanation: The provided answer states that modern jet aircraft FDRs record more than 88 mandatory parameters.

questions.question: The purpose of the compensator capacitance in fuel quantity systems is to compensate for:
options: A. Fuel dielectric changes due to temperature
questions.explanation: The compensator capacitance accounts for changes in fuel dielectric properties caused by temperature variation.

questions.question: Purpose of Bourdon tube:
questions.explanation: Bourdon tubes can be used for pressure sensing and, in certain older instrument systems, temperature indication.

questions.question: EADI full time displayed:
questions.explanation: Attitude is continuously displayed on the EADI.

questions.question: Ratiometer compared to Wheatstone bridge is:
questions.explanation: The provided answer states that the ratiometer is more stable and accurate compared with the Wheatstone bridge arrangement.

questions.question: Cabin air T° sensor is:
questions.explanation: A thermistor element is used to sense cabin air temperature.

questions.question: Power supply of ratiometer is:
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies direct current as the power supply for the ratiometer.

questions.question: Engine speed measurement is required to measure the rotational speed of:
questions.explanation: Engine speed measurement determines the rotational speed of components such as a reciprocating-engine crankshaft or a turbine-engine compressor.

questions.question: Free air temperature:
questions.explanation: Free air temperature is the static temperature of the undisturbed surrounding air.

questions.question: Oil in velocity pickup is used for:
questions.explanation: Oil is used to damp the spring action and reduce unwanted oscillation in the velocity pickup.

questions.question: Drive shaft in magnetic drag cup tacho is:
questions.explanation: A flexible drive shaft transmits engine rotation to the magnetic drag cup tachometer.

questions.question: Pointer in indicating instrument is kept at a specific point by:
questions.explanation: The hairspring provides the controlling torque that keeps the pointer at a specific position.

questions.question: Automatic brightness control inputs to DEU are:
options: A. RLS and Bezel light sensor
B. Fuel flow sensor and thermistor
C. Oil pressure sensor and AOA sensor
questions.explanation: Automatic display brightness information is supplied by the RLS and bezel light sensor.

questions.question: The computer for common display unit is:
questions.explanation: The Display Electronics Unit (DEU) is the computer associated with processing information for common display units.

questions.question: Drive shaft in magnetic drag cup tacho is used to:
options: A. Connect permanent magnet with the engine
questions.explanation: The drive shaft transmits engine rotation to the permanent magnet inside the magnetic drag cup tachometer.

questions.question: Info provided by EICAS to flight crew includes:
options: A. Primary and secondary engine parameter and alert message and advisory/caution
questions.explanation: EICAS provides primary and secondary engine parameters together with alerts, advisories, and cautions.

questions.question: The oil quantity indicating system shows the engine oil quantity data on:
questions.explanation: Engine oil quantity is displayed as a secondary engine parameter on the secondary engine display.

questions.question: The engine pressure ratio (EPR) indicator is a direct indication of:
questions.explanation: EPR provides a direct indication related to the thrust being produced by a turbine engine.

questions.question: What are the components of an engine oil quantity indication system:
options: A. Thermocouple, Bourdon tube and capsule
B. Electrical resistance sensor, floating magnet and reed switches
questions.explanation: The system uses an electrical resistance sensor together with a floating magnet and reed switches to sense oil quantity.

questions.question: Which of the following is electrical type T° measuring device:
questions.explanation: A Wheatstone bridge is an electrical temperature measuring arrangement using changes in resistance.

questions.question: The engine indication are shown on:
questions.explanation: The provided answer identifies the CDU as the display for the engine indications.

questions.question: Which one of the following is NOT the function of an EFIS Control panel:
options: C. Gives maintenance control for the attitude and heading references
questions.explanation: The EFIS control panel controls display presentation and selection; maintenance control of attitude and heading references is not its normal function.

questions.question: Which of the following display units have the aircraft's directional reference:
questions.explanation: The EHSI provides aircraft directional and navigation reference information.

questions.question: Which one of the following computer is commonly used for symbol/graphic generation for display units employed on BOEING aircrafts:
questions.explanation: The Display Electronics Unit (DEU) is commonly used for symbol and graphic generation for Boeing display units.

questions.question: How many display units are installed commonly on large commercially operated aircraft with exception of some turboprop aircraft:
questions.explanation: Large commercial aircraft commonly have six display units, although some turboprop aircraft differ.

questions.question: What does the RED color indicate on the weather radar indication of the ND:
questions.explanation: Red on the weather radar display indicates severe precipitation or storm activity.

questions.question: Which of the following indicates pitch & roll info:
questions.explanation: The EADI provides aircraft attitude information including pitch and roll.

questions.question: Additional System Monitoring / Status Parameter:
questions.explanation: Door and hydraulic indications are examples of additional system monitoring and status parameters.

questions.question: System Function Check Parameter:
options: A. Primary and secondary engine parameter
questions.explanation: Primary and secondary engine parameters can be used to check system function and monitor engine operation.
